text: In ORD101, `GetArtDesc` returns the full 50-char `ARDESC`, but the screen's `ARTDESC` field is declared 30A (program-described from the DSPF), so article descriptions are silently truncated to 30 chars on both the subfile and detail screens.
`gh-as-agent pr --body-file` does not support bash process substitution `<(...)` for the body file; write the PR body to a real temp file first.
The SAMCO repo under this environment lives at `./samco-prague` (not repo root); `docs/scope.md`, `docs/glossary.md`, `docs/reading-rpg.md` there define the slice-by-slice reverse-engineering scope.

ORD101's detail-line save (`S02act`) requires two unmodified Enters: after an edit, the DDS `CHANGE(27)` record-level indicator being on redisplays the recalculated line instead of saving; only a second Enter with no further change commits the `UPDATE` to `DETORD1`.

VAT300's `chainVATDEF` caches the last-chained VATCODE in a static record buffer and clears it on every miss, so repeated lookups of the same invalid/unknown VAT code never hit a cache and re-chain every time.

When a golden-master rule/quirk has no seed-data combination to exercise it, add fixture rows inline in that case's inputs rather than editing data/*.csv, since other slices/agents depend on that shared seed data staying as-is.
